big-news.text: Marius Borg Høiby stays in custody with an ankle monitor at Skaugum. The appeals court overturned Monday's release order and said it didn't buy his explanation for a positive alcohol test, which he blamed on mouthwash and fermented apple juice. His appeal trial is in February.

The Parliamentary Ombud found that every hospital it inspected, including Lovisenberg and Ahus near Oslo, had kept patients in restraint belts for illegally long periods, some for 4 to over 18 days. She's calling for immediate action.
More Ukrainian asylum seekers are arriving in Norway this autumn. A researcher links it to a hard winter in Ukraine, with Russia bombing power infrastructure.

whats-changing.text: Your Norgespris power deal ends Dec 31 and does not renew on its own. Orders for 2027 open Jan 5, and if you order by Jan 14 it applies from Jan 1. The proposed price is 56.25 øre/kWh including VAT, but that isn't final until the budget passes in December.
PostNord raises prices on Dec 1: about 3.9% for parcel lockers and service points, and 5.8% for home delivery.

oslo.text: A district-heating pipe burst at Grønland last evening and threw rocks up to 30 m into the air. About 100 people were evacuated and roughly 1,500 homes lost heat and hot water. Everything was back by early morning and nobody was hurt, though some showers may still run cold.
Because of the leak, buses 37 and 60 are detouring eastbound this morning, with a few stops skipped near the bus terminal.

be-aware.text: A landslide has closed the Bergen Line between Voss and Dale, so expect delays and some cancelled trains.
A serious crash has closed the northbound E18 at Larvik for several hours, with traffic detoured via Fv 256.

fun-and-free.text: Top pick: Fjord Oslo starts tonight and runs until Sunday, 18:00 to 23:00, along the waterfront at Tjuvholmen, Aker Brygge, Rådhusplassen and Akershusstranda. Saturday or Sunday evening is perfect after you land.
The Frank Znort Quartet plays a free show at BLÅ on Sunday at 15:00.
Oslo Zine Fest has a free market at ROM (Maridalsveien 3) from 12:00 to 17:00 on Saturday and Sunday.
Chamber Music Week ends with a free percussion ensemble concert on Saturday at 15:00 at the Norwegian Academy of Music.
